candidates.title: Will it rain in Columbus on Nov 14, 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the total precipitation at CLICMH in Columbus in Nov 14, 2026 is strictly greater than 0 inches, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:

Reading weather data
Data for CLICMH can be found at https://weather.com/kalshi.
“Trace” amounts (T) and missing daily precipitation values are counted as 0 inches.

candidates.title: Will the Republican party win the Senate in 2028?
candidates.rules_primary: If the Republican party has won control of the Senate in 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: This market may be determined early based on a consensus of media calls projecting control of the U.S. Senate. See full rules for details. Otherwise, victory will be determined by the party identification of the President pro tempore of the Senate on February 1, 2029.

candidates.title: Will the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, for November 20, 2026 be above $0.90?
candidates.rules_primary: If the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, as reported in the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report scheduled for publication on November 20, 2026 is above $0.90, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: This market uses advertised retail prices, not transaction prices. The relevant value is the “This Week” Wtd Avg Price for the row with Commodity “Avocados,” Variety “Hass,” and Unit “each” in the National Conventional Summary section of the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report. Prices for other avocado varieties, sizes, package counts, organic avocados, regional tables, “Last Week,” or “Last Year” do not count.

candidates.title: Will the rate of CPI inflation be above 4.2% for the year ending in November 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases by more than 4.2% in the twelve months ending November 2026 (as represented by the one-decimal place value reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics), then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: In the case of a delay in data caused by a federal government shutdown impacting the reliability of the Source Agency, the market’s latest Expiration Date will be extended to the sooner of the release of the Underlying or six months after the end of the government shutdown

candidates.title: CPI month-over-month in Nov 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the CPI month-over-month is exactly -0.2% in Nov 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

candidates.title: Will A bill ending self rule in Washington DC becomes law before Jan 1, 2027?
candidates.yes_sub_title: A bill ending self rule in Washington DC
candidates.rules_primary: If a bill ending self rule in Washington DC becomes law before Jan 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.

candidates.title: Will Trump nominate Stephen Miran as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System before Jan 1, 2027?
candidates.rules_primary: If Stephen Miran is nominated as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027. then the market resolves to Yes.

candidates.title: Will CPI core year-over-year for Dec 2026 be exactly 3.0%?
candidates.rules_primary: If CPI core year-over-year for Dec 2026 is exactly 3.0%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: “Core CPI” means the 12-month percent change in the CPI-U for all items less food and energy, as first reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics and rounded to one decimal place. Subsequent revisions will not affect settlement.

candidates.title: Will the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U in December 2030 be above 3.5%?
candidates.rules_primary: If the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted, in December 2030 is above 3.5%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The initially reported value for December 2030 will be used. This market concerns the 12-month percentage change for December 2030, not the annual-average percentage change for the specified year.
